nodes.description: IERC20 token contract held by the timelock; target of the external transfer in release().
Address of the beneficiary that receives the released tokens.
Timestamp after which token release becomes enabled; compared against block.timestamp.
Constructor validating releaseTime > block.timestamp and initializing _token, _beneficiary and _releaseTime.
Public function that checks block.timestamp >= _releaseTime, reads the token balance and transfers all held tokens to the beneficiary.
View getter returning the held token address _token.
View getter returning the beneficiary address _beneficiary.
View getter returning the release timestamp _releaseTime.
Derived constructor that instantiates TokenTimelock with hardcoded token, beneficiary and releaseTime values.
block.timestamp used both in the constructor require and in the release() time gate.
Low-level external call to the token contract performed through SafeERC20.safeTransfer, transferring control to a callee.
SafeERC20 library wrapper that performs the external token transfer call.
Constructor parameter token, assigned to state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary, assigned to state variable _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseTime, validated against block.timestamp and assigned to _releaseTime.
Local variable holding the token balance of this contract, computed in release().

edges.reason: Constructor execution gate require(releaseTime > block.timestamp) depends on the miner-controllable block.timestamp value.
release() is gated on require(block.timestamp >= _releaseTime), a timestamp dependency controlling token release.
State variable _releaseTime is compared against block.timestamp inside release() to decide whether tokens can be withdrawn.
release() calls SafeERC20.safeTransfer, entering library code that performs the externally visible transfer before returning.
safeTransfer performs an external low-level call to the token contract, handing control to an arbitrary callee with no reentrancy guard in TokenTimelock.
State variable _token is the target of the external call, so a malicious token implementation can re-enter release().
release() reads _token.balanceOf(address(this)) to determine the amount to transfer.
The local variable amount is assigned from _token.balanceOf inside release().
Local variable amount is forwarded as the value argument of safeTransfer.
State variable _beneficiary is forwarded as the recipient argument of safeTransfer.
Constructor parameter token is written into state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary is written into state variable _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseTime is written into state variable _releaseTime.
Constructor parameter releaseTime is validated against block.timestamp before being stored, coupling user input to time-based access control.
TokenTimelock constructor initializes state variable _token.
TokenTimelock constructor initializes state variable _beneficiary.
TokenTimelock constructor initializes state variable _releaseTime.
RubicTokenLock constructor invokes the base TokenTimelock constructor with hardcoded arguments.
token() returns the state variable _token.
beneficiary() returns the state variable _beneficiary.
releaseTime() returns the state variable _releaseTime.
